question: In a refrigeration system, _____ equipment is used for measuring the dry bulb and wet bulb temperature simultaneously.
solution:
The correct answer is __Psychrometer****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Psychrometer__ is an instrument used in refrigeration systems.
 
• A psychrometer consists of two thermometers: a dry bulb and a wet bulb.
 
• It is used to measure relative humidity and determine air properties.
 
• The dry bulb thermometer measures the ambient air temperature.
 
• The wet bulb thermometer has a wick soaked in water that cools as water evaporates.
 
• The temperature difference between the two thermometers helps calculate humidity levels and other air properties.
 
• Psychrometers are often used in HVAC systems and meteorology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Manometer:**
 
 
• A manometer is used to measure fluid pressure in pipes or vessels.
 
• It typically uses liquid columns in tubes to determine pressure differences.
 
 
 
• **Barometer:**
 
 
• A barometer measures atmospheric pressure.
 
• It is commonly used in weather forecasting and altitude determination.
 
 
 
• **Orificemeter:**
 
 
• An orificemeter is used to measure fluid flow rates in pipelines.
 
• It works based on the principle of pressure drop across an orifice plate.
